name: vital
notes: Vital wavetable synth. Four macros; any number of parameters can be assigned to one macro, and the Mod Wheel / Pitch Wheel are modulation sources in the matrix. Most parameters accept MIDI Learn, but MIDI Learn assignments are global (not saved per patch) — so map once: filter cutoff (or Macro 1 driving it) ← CC74, Macros 1-4 ← CC21-24, volume ← CC7. For wobble bass, put the 'filter' or 'macro' lane on the parameter the patch wobbles, or drive the patch's LFO rate from the mod wheel. Glides: enable Legato + Portamento in the voice settings; 'glide' notes overlap by legato_overlap beats. Pitch automation assumes a ±2 semitone bend range (in MPE mode Vital uses 48). For a full tape-stop dive set Vital's pitch bend range to 12 and pitch_bend_range here to 12.
